claim_boundary: This is an experiment rejection record, not an end-to-end scan accuracy result.
reason: Independent rendered confirmation produced three false accepts. Raising the threshold removed the observed false accepts but left unstable and insufficient coverage, so this design was not deployed.
replacement: A single decision model fed by inclusive and strict staff-removed detector evidence; both detector views are features of the same guard rather than separate voting models.
scope: Rendered local pitch-repair visual guard using one inclusive notehead detector.
